notes.title: Speedrun Update 1.2 + Original Soundtrack now on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Welcome to the Steam Summer Sale 2019! We are excited to announce we have added "Speedrun Mode" to the game. TwinCop is an extremely unique game to speed run, and we hope this mode will make those runs more interesting and enjoyable to do with a [u][b]locked seed[/b][/u]. This means those pesky card swiping mini games and button hacking mini games won't rely on RNG per run.

If you do a speed run of the game please let us know on Twitter ([url=twitter.com/finitereflect]@finitereflect[/url]) and share here on the Steam forums!

We have also added the OST as a DLC to the game, and will be hosting the music on Spotify soon.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29838462/ceb45ce112e4d82ab75ce16b59f8325afc5f1eec.jpg[/img]

[h1]Version 1.2.2 (0)[/h1]
[list]
[*] Speedrun Mode: adds a timer to the screen! Displays your final time at credits scene.
[*] LOCKED SEED in speedrun mode. Ensures randomized elements are less random.
[*] Loading time discounted in speedrun mode. This ensures that loading lag is not accounted for in your speedrun time, making them more fair across the board.
[*] Improved performance of audio system
[*] Cleaned up codebase
[*] Updated text rendering system
[*] Improved performance of pause screen
[*] Updated error messaging for leaderboards
[*] Fixed some issues impacting deleting save slots
[*] Fixed bug affecting settings menu in arcade mode
[/list]

As usual, if you run into any bugs or issues let us know in the discussion forums. Happy cooperating!

<3 Kartik

notes.title: Balance Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello all! We've been busy at work making our console ports and collecting feedback from players. We've watched a number of let's plays and streams of the game (thank you to everyone who's playing it and streaming, ya'll rock!) and we are seeing some places where the difficulty is not what we intended.
This update is intended to address that, as well as fix some Steam-specific issues impacting being able to accomplish some achievements. Patch notes are below!

[h1]Version 1.1.0 (0)[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved the balance of the first factory escape level
[*] Improved the balance of the final boss final phase
[*] Improved balance of the first boss second phase
[*] Fixed waypoints in second driving minigame
[*] Destroyed poptop machines have "out of order" signs on them, to help players accomplish the achievement
[*] Fixed a few steam achievements not triggering correctly sometimes
[/list]

We hope those of you are enjoying the game are able to enjoy it some more, and for those of you who are playing through the campaign for the first time, we hope these updates make it a great playthrough.

As always, please post in the community forums if you are running into any issues and we will try and assist you as quickly as we can.

<3 Kartik

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Reviews and feedback![/h1]
Before I get to talking about the update, I just wanted to remind ya'll to leave reviews if you're enjoying the game! If you're not, or are running into trouble, please post in the community forums so we can help.

[h1]Hotfix 1.0.1[/h1]
The first update (of many to come) is here! We've addressed some feedback, fixed some bugs, and improved the balance in some places. The biggest change is an update to the settings menu. We've added the ability to invert your controls, in case your controller isn't defaulting to the correct settings or if you just prefer to play with inverted controls. See the screenshot below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29838462/de55c8b4ee83ec872c900f048528451941b3942c.png[/img]
[i]Updated Settings[/i]

[h1]Fixes and Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added controller inversion options in settings menu
[*] Redesigned the gameplay section of settings to account for the added options above
[*] Removed "rumble" options, since rumble is not working right now. Will investigate fixing rumble for a future update.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing forklift tutorial from appearing sometimes
[*] Fixed a bug causing soft-locks in the main menu
[*] Improved how settings are loaded in game scenes
[*] Fixed lasers not damaging forklift
[*] Improved balance for first factory escape sequence (easier)
[/list]

If you run into any issues, please post in the Community forums! We are currently working on console ports, in addition to trying to get some rest and recovery after an exhausting launch... however we take community very seriously and will respond as soon as we can.

Thank you to everyone who's bought the game so far, we're so happy that everyone seems to be enjoying the game so far.

<3 Kartik
